name: PBS PS5
loaderTransport: raw ELF over TCP; no prefix; close after complete transfer
firmwareGuard: pbs_ps5_find_offsets selects only explicit measured firmware builds or listed audited family releases. Unknown firmware is rejected before capture injection. Request geometry bounds are checked before injection.

api.video: GET /frames: big-endian uint32 byteLength, uint32 PTS90k, H.264 Annex-B payload
api.audio: GET /audio: big-endian uint32 byteLength, uint32 timestamp, little-endian float32 PCM payload
api.controller: POST /input/connect, /input/state, /input/disconnect with X-PBS-Input: 1 and owned X-PBS-Controller token
api.rateControl: GET /config.json rate_control: null or version1 with active/pending bitrate and minimum QP
api.partyConnect: POST /party/connect with X-PBS-Input: 1; token and player index returned
api.partyState: POST /party/state for Players 2-4 with token and state CSV
api.partyUsers: GET /party/users with active controller token; logged-in local user names
api.partyAvatar: GET /party/avatar?user_id=decimal with active controller token; bounded profile image

encoderControls.acceptance: Advertised only after native pre-start bitrate acceptance and successful capture startup; target is not measured output rate.

partyMode.allocation: first successful connection is Player 1, then Players 2-4
partyMode.media: shared encoder, separate video/audio readers per Android client
partyMode.profileSelection: PS5 native user picker; mapping of user ID to virtual pad not hardware-verified
